//: adapter-static writes to build/, but Vercel's SvelteKit preset looks for adapter-vercel output in .vercel/output and then falls back to public/. Without this the build succeeds and the deploy fails. Delete outputDirectory when swapping to adapter-vercel for the dynamic phase; the headers and rewrite below move into hooks/handlers at that point too, since Vercel ignores static/_headers and static/_redirects (those are for Cloudflare Pages and Netlify).

rewrites.//: Campaign slugs and donor status tokens are created in the browser, so nothing past / can be prerendered. Vercel checks the filesystem before rewrites, so real assets under /_app and /ocr still win.

headers.//: The header the open disclosure decision needs, in place before any real receiving detail can reach it.
A campaign URL carries a slug and a donor status URL carries a token; neither should follow the visitor onward.
Fingerprinted by the build — new content means a new filename, so this is safe.
~15MB OCR engine, versioned with the dependency. Re-fetching it per scan would hurt on mobile data.
